    row=\"\"

        elif g>r and g>b+20: c='G'               # green/yellow
        elif r>120 and g>100 and b<90: c='Y'     # yellow
        elif b>r and b>g: c='B'
        else: c='?'
        row+=c
    out.append(row)
print(\"\\n\".join(out))
EOF"
